name: Cometary-Threnody
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs magnetic pole anomalies, stark under a black sky.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
